subject: Invoice #INV-2041 charged twice
body: Hi, we were charged twice for invoice INV-2041 ($4,200 each). This looks like a duplicate charge — please refund it when you get a chance.

subject: API returns 500 on webhook delivery
body: Our webhook endpoint started receiving 500s from your API about an hour ago. Nothing changed on our side. Can someone take a look?

subject: This is the THIRD time I'm asking
body: I have asked THREE TIMES to delete our account and all data under GDPR and nobody has done it. If this isn't resolved today I am escalating to our legal team.

subject: Do you offer annual pricing?
body: We're evaluating your platform for a 200-seat rollout. Do you offer annual plans with a discount? Would love a quick call next week.

subject: Feature request: SSO for teams
body: Would be great if team plans supported SSO/SAML. No rush, just wanted to put it on your radar. Thanks!

subject: Billing error still not fixed after 3 tickets
body: This is absolutely infuriating. THIRD ticket about the same duplicate charge on INV-2041 and I keep getting canned responses from people who clearly didn't read a word I wrote. I'm at my wit's end here. Please escalate this to someone senior who will actually fix it. I need it resolved this week — no huge rush, just a real answer.
